purpose: Render calendar fractions of faction/chamber disagreement from one read-only vote snapshot.

public_surface.measure: (data, faction_ids, months, split) -> (intervals, counters); identical vote IDs counted once; conflicting IDs or incomplete named totals fail
public_surface.breaks: (half, quarter) -> half-year jumps over BREAK_THRESHOLD with same-boundary quarterly comparison
public_surface.validate_page: HTML -> None or ValueError on forbidden prose, scripts, missing noindex
public_surface.label: interval -> inclusive visible dates
public_surface.matrix: measurement, names -> unsortable matrix without totals
public_surface.page: snapshot, names, split, digest -> (validated HTML, jumps)
public_surface.main: CLI --selftest or --votes PATH; output OUT defaults to site/time.html

depends_on.legacy: Existing canonical position computation; no sidecar
Explicitly required by task; canonical threshold loader has private name
Existing prose extraction, noindex and script checks
PyYAML already installed and used by render_axes

disposability.reason: Read-only inputs and regenerable HTML; no persistent state or migrations. Can be replaced behind this contract and synthetic oracle.
disposability.removal: Remove build_site renderer call, time.html output requirement, this script and contract; delete generated time.html.
disposability.tool_limit: project_context capabilities and disposability both fail: No module named project_context. This is a manual verdict, not a passed project gate.

ponytail.step1: Explicit user request; needed temporal view is absent in existing renderers.
ponytail.step4: Reuse canonical faction_position, _arrow_split, CSS/frame, existing YAML dependency; no new dependencies.
